name: Sichuan Neautus Traditional Chinese Medicine Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Neautus Traditional Chinese Medicine Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of traditional Chinese medicine decoction-ready products. The company offers toxic decoction-ready medicines, including rhizoma pinelliae preparatum, ginger processed pinelliae, rhizoma pinelliae preparate, white aconitum carmichaelii, and black aconitum carmichaelii products; non-toxic decoction-ready medicines, such as Fritillaria cirrhosa, Dwarf lilyturf, Astragalus, Stir-fried Ziziphi spinosae semen, Coptis root, and Angelica sinensis.
